missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for and verify that the edit feedback screen is displayed. This should check for the presence of key elements that indicate the feedback form is open, such as the feedback text input field, submit button, or screen title. Return True if the screen is visible, raise an exception if not found within timeout.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'hpx_feedback_page_title' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object
Wait for 'edit_feedback' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object
Wait for 'send_feedback_submit_btn' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object
Return True if all elements are found
If any element is not found within timeout, allow wait_for_object to raise exception

missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate the 'tell your experience' text input field on the feedback form and input the provided text string. This method should wait for the text field to be interactable, clear any existing content, and then send the specified text. Parameters: text (str) - The text content to input into the experience field.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'edit_feedback' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object
Click on 'edit_feedback' to focus the field using self.driver.click
Clear existing content in 'edit_feedback' using self.driver.clear or select all and delete
Send the provided text parameter to 'edit_feedback' using self.driver.send_keys
Optionally verify text was entered by calling get_entered_text() or similar

missing_methods.intent: Get entered tell your experience text value
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Retrieve and return the current text value from the 'tell your experience' input field. This should read the actual value attribute or text content of the input element and return it as a string. Return type: str - The current text value in the experience field.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'edit_feedback' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object
Get the 'Value.Value' attribute from 'edit_feedback' using self.driver.get_attribute
Return the retrieved text value as a string
Handle None or empty values appropriately

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Verify that the text in the 'tell your experience' field has been truncated to the expected maximum character length. This method should get the current text value, check its length against the expected maximum, and assert that it equals the maximum length (indicating truncation occurred). Parameters: expected_max_length (int) - The maximum allowed character count. Should raise an assertion error if the text length does not match the expected truncated length.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'edit_feedback' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object
Call get_tell_your_experience_text_value() or self.driver.get_attribute('edit_feedback', 'Value.Value') to retrieve current text
Calculate the length of the retrieved text using len()
Wait for 'edit_feedback_char_count' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object
Get the character count display text from 'edit_feedback_char_count' using self.driver.get_attribute with 'Name' attribute
Assert that len(text) equals expected_max_length parameter
Optionally assert that character count display shows expected format like '2000/2000'
Raise AssertionError with descriptive message if length does not match expected_max_length
Return True if all assertions pass
